comment: Curated source mutants of graalgo's lowering/runtime (SPEC 5.7, GG-0034). Each 'old' must occur EXACTLY once in 'file' (the tool refuses ambiguous mutants). A mutant must be KILLED by the per-push differential gate (make snapshot-check); a survivor is either killed by a new corpus program or carries a 'survivorJustification'.

mutants.description: signed % lowered to Math.floorMod (sign of divisor instead of dividend)
mutants.old: yield unsigned ? Long.remainderUnsigned(l, r) : l % r;
mutants.new: yield unsigned ? Long.remainderUnsigned(l, r) : Math.floorMod(l, r);

mutants.old: yield unsigned ? Long.divideUnsigned(l, r) : l / r;
mutants.new: yield unsigned ? Long.divideUnsigned(l, r) : Math.floorDiv(l, r);

mutants.old: yield unsigned ? Long.divideUnsigned(l, r) : l / r;
yield unsigned ? Long.remainderUnsigned(l, r) : l % r;

mutants.description: sub-64-bit integer results not truncated to the operand width (no wraparound)
<< by >= 64 uses Java count masking instead of yielding 0
signed >> by >= 64 yields 0 instead of sign fill

mutants.old: yield unsigned ? l >>> r : l >> r;

mutants.description: negative shift count does not panic (<<)

mutants.old: yield operandKind.isUintKind() ? Long.compareUnsigned(l, r) : Long.compare(l, r);

mutants.description: float32 arithmetic not rounded to float32 when consumed as double
unary op result (long carrier) not truncated to its width
index bounds check off by one (s[len(s)] admitted)
mutants.old: boolean bad = signed ? (idx < 0 || idx >= len) : Long.compareUnsigned(idx, len) >= 0;
mutants.new: boolean bad = signed ? (idx < 0 || idx > len) : Long.compareUnsigned(idx, len) > 0;

mutants.old: boolean bad = b.signed ? (b.v < 0 || b.v > limit) : Long.compareUnsigned(b.v, limit) > 0;
mutants.new: boolean bad = b.signed ? (b.v < 0 || b.v > limit + 1) : Long.compareUnsigned(b.v, limit + 1) > 0;

mutants.description: x++/x-- on an int-carrier variable does not wrap at its width
mutants.old: case Int -> frame.setInt(slot, extendInt(frame.getInt(slot) + (int) delta, kind));

mutants.description: string comparison on signed bytes (non-ASCII sorts before ASCII)
mutants.old:
int a = bytes[i] & 0xFF;
            int b = other.bytes[i] & 0xFF;
mutants.new:
int a = bytes[i];
            int b = other.bytes[i];

mutants.description: range over string: invalid leading byte yields the byte, not U+FFFD
map delete does not decrement len
boxed float equality makes NaN equal to NaN (NaN map keys collapse)
defers run FIFO instead of LIFO
